page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8469C processor operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 6.0 GB of RAM per core.

For parallel processing and accelerated workloads, the instance includes a single GPU equipped with 96 GB of dedicated VRAM. This server does not feature any local storage, meaning all operating system and application data must reside on network-attached storage volumes. Network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps, and the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring substantial GPU memory and dedicated compute resources. The combination of 16 dedicated Xeon cores, 96.0 GB of system RAM, and 96 GB of VRAM makes this instance suitable for machine learning inference, data science pipelines, and specialized parallel computing tasks.
